pages.title: Scylla
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Acropolis: Scylla's storm spears, astrape and ceraunus, brontes, the essence of the storm, lacrima and the azure sea shield, the Clawdian's claw, and the azure seastone of the drowned halls. Needs Maledictus as well.$(br2)$(thing)Relics$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(thing)70 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After The Leviathan and Maledictus.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill Scylla$(n)$(br2)Pays 12 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
